local function navigationMetrics(w: number,h: number)
 local short,large=h<500,w>=1500 and h>=700
 local landscape=w>=548 and h<400
 local tile=math.clamp(math.floor(math.min(w*.112,h*.2)),92,190)
 if short then tile=math.clamp(math.floor((h-148)/2)-12,64,84) end
 if w<600 then
  tile=math.min(110,math.floor((w-48)/3))
  if short then tile=64 end
 end
 local width,height=tile,tile
 if large then width=math.floor(math.min(w*.115,228));height=math.floor(width*1.19) end
 -- Shrink the fitted artwork by 22%; reserve enough caption width for TOWERS at 14px.
 width,height=math.max(64,math.floor(width*.78)),math.max(44,math.floor(height*.78))
 local gap=10
 if large then gap=16 end
 local rowGap,columns=16,2
 if short and w<600 then rowGap=10 end
 if landscape then width,height,gap,rowGap,columns=64,48,8,4,2 end
 local x,y=12,math.max(100,math.floor(h*.19))
 if large then x=math.floor(w*.0284);y=math.max(100,math.floor(h*.155)) end
 if short then y=66 end
 if landscape then y=68 end
 if short and w<600 then y=12 end
 return {width=width,height=height,step=width+gap,rowGap=rowGap,x=x,y=y,large=large,columns=columns,compactLandscape=landscape}
end
